key_reasoning.reason: Five components modified across four architectural layers: ConferenceController (API), ConferenceRepository (Persistence), ConferenceService (Service), api.js (UI/API client), and ConferenceListPage.jsx (UI). Exceeds the 3-4 component L threshold; the UI subsystem plus the full backend stack makes this the widest scope dimension.

LIKE wildcard sanitization (% and _ escaping) is implemented inline in ConferenceService.getAllConferences with no pre-existing reusable utility in the codebase for this pattern. The JPQL ESCAPE clause and the service-level replace chain are both new. The sanitization auto-bump floor of L (4) applies. The debounce and AbortController patterns are well-established and carry no additional risk.

All four layers in scope: UI (ConferenceListPage.jsx — filter controls, debounce, date range validation), API (ConferenceController — new query params, date range guard), Service (ConferenceService — wildcard escaping, param forwarding), DB-Persistence (ConferenceRepository — new JPQL findAllFiltered query with ESCAPE clause). No schema migration.
